components.notes: Lazy live wrapper owns the discovery settings controller for the Settings → Discovery page; deterministic visual coverage remains on workspace_discovery_settings.

Settings → Discovery: where organisers on Catch and organisers not on Catch yet appear on the website, as a CatchTable of rules with a switch per audience (stacked rows on phones), the fixed rules stated as text, the homepage organisers band minimum and the claim-your-page button, reset to defaults and save; only the owner edits.
